_comment: League/park context needed for wOBA, wRC+ and WAR. These are PLACEHOLDER values (roughly MLB-shaped) until real league-wide totals for this school's league are available. Swap them out once that data exists -- nothing in advanced-stats.js should ever need to change, only these numbers.

wOBAWeights._comment: Linear-weight run values per event, FanGraphs 'Guts!' style. wBB excludes intentional walks (uBB only). Source: FanGraphs wOBA glossary (https://library.fangraphs.com/offense/woba/).

positionalAdjustmentsPer600PA._comment: FanGraphs-style defensive positional adjustments (runs per 600 PA). Used only if a player's position is known.
